title: Umhlaba womsebenzi
description: Ten short stories about the world of work: a Durban hairdresser with blunt scissors, a bachelor tailor in Pietermaritzburg who sews a bride's bodice, a young cook in Ballito whose pumpkin porridge turns sticky, a night guard in Pinetown whose bulldog finds an open door, a KwaMashu teacher's folk tale about a short, clever hero, a student nurse in Nkandla, a farmer near Mtubatuba with her goats, chickens and young ox, a digger near Mkhuze who works under a marula tree, a game guard at Hluhluwe who meets a bushbuck, a steenbok and a mamba, and a researcher's diary about otters on a Drakensberg plateau.

lessons.title: Isikele esinobuthuntu
lessons.summary: In a small hair shop in Durban, Nomaxabiso Msane washes the hair of Nokuzola, who has a job interview at a big office the next day: the shampoo smells of flowers, the blunt old scissors irk Nomaxabiso, she straightens Nokuzola's hair little by little, and the next afternoon Nokuzola phones to say she got the job.
lessons.text:
UNomaxabiso Msane ulungisa izinwele zabantu eThekwini. Unendlu encane yokusebenzela eduze kwesitolo esikhulu. Njalo ekuseni uvula umnyango ngehora lesikhombisa. Ubeka izinto zakhe etafuleni: amabhulashi, isikele, indwangu ehlanzekile nebhodlela elikhulu leshampu. Ishampu iyinto ebaluleke kakhulu emsebenzini wakhe.

NgoLwesibili kufika intombi egama layo nguNokuzola. Ithi: "Sawubona, Nomaxabiso. Kusasa nginengxoxo yomsebenzi ehhovisi elikhulu edolobheni. Ngifuna izinwele zami zibukeke kahle kakhulu." UNomaxabiso uyaqhesha. Uthi: "Hlala phansi, ntombi yami. Sizoqala ngeshampu."

UNomaxabiso ugeza izinwele zikaNokuzola ngamanzi afudumele. Uthela ishampu esandleni sakhe, bese eyihlikihla ezinweleni. Ishampu inuka kamnandi njengezimbali. UNokuzola uvala amehlo. Uthi: "Le shampu yinhle kakhulu. Uyithenga kuphi?" UNomaxabiso uyaqhesha futhi. Uthi: "Yimfihlo yami."

UNokuzola uyakhuluma ngomsebenzi omusha. Uthi: "Ngifuna ukusebenza ngekhompyutha, ngibale imali yabantu. Kodwa ngiyesaba. Abantu abaningi bafuna lo msebenzi." UNomaxabiso uyaqhesha. Uthi: "Ungesabi. Uma izinwele zakho zibukeka kahle, nawe uzoba namandla." UNokuzola uyahleka kancane. Uthi: "Kulungile. Ngizozama."

Emva kokugeza, uNomaxabiso uthatha isikele. Ufuna ukusika iziphetho zezinwele. Kodwa isikele asisiki kahle. Sinobuthuntu. Uzama kabili, kathathu. Ubuthuntu besikele buyamdinisa kakhulu. Uthi: "Lesi sikele siyangidinisa namuhla! Ngasithenga ngonyaka odlule, manje sinobuthuntu." Uthatha esinye isikele esincane. Leso sikele asinabo ubuthuntu, sibukhali. UNomaxabiso uqhubeka nomsebenzi.

Manje uNomaxabiso uqala ukukleza izinwele. Ukleza ngebhulashi nangensimbi eshisayo. Ukleza kancane kancane, ingxenye ngengxenye. UNokuzola uyabona ukuthi izinwele zakhe ziba zinde futhi zithambile. Uthi: "Nomaxabiso, ukleza kahle kunabo bonke abantu engibaziyo!"

UNomaxabiso uthi: "Ungazigezi izinwele zakho ngaphambi kwengxoxo. Uma uzigeza, kuzodingeka ngiphinde ngizikleze." Bobabili bayahleka.

UNokuzola ukhokha imali, aphume. UNomaxabiso uhlanza itafula lakhe. Ubheka isikele esinobuthuntu. Uthi: "Kusasa ngizothenga isikele esisha. Angifuni ukudiniswa yilesi sikele futhi."

NgoLwesithathu emini ucingo lukaNomaxabiso luyakhala. NguNokuzola. Uthi: "Nomaxabiso! Ngiwutholile umsebenzi!" UNomaxabiso uyaqhesha, ehleli yedwa endlini yakhe yokusebenzela.

Imibuzo:
UNomaxabiso usebenzaphi?
Ulungisa izinwele zabantu endlini encane eduze kwesitolo esikhulu eThekwini.
Kungani uNokuzola efuna ukuthi izinwele zakhe zibukeke kahle?
Ngoba kusasa unengxoxo yomsebenzi ehhovisi elikhulu.
UNomaxabiso uqala ngani?
Uqala ngokugeza izinwele ngeshampu.
Yini edinisa uNomaxabiso?
Ubuthuntu besikele buyamdinisa.
UNomaxabiso ukleza izinwele kanjani?
Ukleza kancane kancane ngebhulashi nangensimbi eshisayo.

lessons.title: Ubhadi lukaSthandiwe
lessons.summary: Lulamile Ngcongo, a forty-year-old bachelor, sews clothes in a small shop in Pietermaritzburg: Sthandiwe Zondo comes to have the bodice of her wedding dress made, cannot decide between three cloths until Lulamile helps her choose, watches him shake the dust out of the white cloth, and at the fitting the bodice is a little tight until he lets it out.
lessons.text:
ULulamile Ngcongo uthunga izingubo eMgungundlovu. Unesitolo esincane edolobheni, futhi usebenza yedwa. Uneminyaka engamashumi amane, kodwa akashadile. Uyimpohlo. Abantu bayahleka bathi: "ULulamile uthunga izingubo zemishado eminingi, kodwa yena uyimpohlo!" ULulamile uyahleka nabo. Uthi: "Impohlo nayo idinga umsebenzi."

NgoMsombuluko ekuseni kufika intombi egama layo nguSthandiwe Zondo. Uzoshada ngoNhlangulana. Uthi: "Lulamile, ngifuna ubhadi olusha lwengubo yami yomshado. Ubhadi kumele lube luhle kakhulu." ULulamile uthi: "Kulungile. Ake ngikukhombise izindwangu zami."

ULulamile ubeka izindwangu ezintathu etafuleni. Eyokuqala imhlophe, eyesibili inombala wobisi, eyesithathu inezimbali ezincane. USthandiwe uyazibheka zonke. Uthatha eyokuqala, bese eyibeka phansi. Uthatha eyesithathu, bese eyibeka phansi futhi. Uthi: "Angazi! Zonke zinhle. Ngicela ungikhethise, Lulamile."

ULulamile uyajabula ukumkhethisa. Uthi: "Umshado wakho uzoba sesontweni, emini. Ngicabanga ukuthi indwangu emhlophe izokufanela kakhulu. Ubhadi olumhlophe luzobukeka kahle elangeni." USthandiwe uyavuma. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga ngokungikhethisa. Ngizothatha emhlophe."

ULulamile uthatha indwangu emhlophe, ayiphathe ngezandla zombili. Uyayihlukuza kathathu. Uthuli luyaphuma endwangwini. Uthi: "Njalo ngihlukuza indwangu ngaphambi kokuthi ngiyisike. Angifuni uthuli olubi engubeni yomshado." Bese ekala umzimba kaSthandiwe ngentambo yokukala. Ubhala ubude nobubanzi encwadini yakhe.

ULulamile usebenza izinsuku eziyishumi. Usika indwangu, ayithunge ngomshini wakhe omdala. Ubhadi luqala ukubonakala. Kusihlwa uyaluhlukuza ubhadi, aluphathe ekukhanyeni, alubheke kahle. Uthi: "Impohlo ayinamfazi, kodwa inezandla ezinhle."

NgoLwesihlanu olulandelayo uSthandiwe uyabuya. Ugqoka ubhadi. Kodwa ubhadi luyamcindezela kancane. Uthi: "Lulamile, angikwazi ukuphefumula kahle!" ULulamile uyahleka. Uthi: "Ungakhathazeki. Ngizoluvula kancane eceleni." Uyaluvula, aphinde aluthunge. Manje ubhadi lumfanele kahle.

USthandiwe uthi: "Ngiyabonga, Lulamile. Kufanele nawe uze emshadweni wami." ULulamile uthi: "Ngizofika. Mhlawumbe ngizothola umfazi khona, ngiyeke ukuba yimpohlo!" Bobabili bayahleka.

NgoNhlangulana uSthandiwe ushada esontweni. ULulamile uhlala ngemuva. USthandiwe ungena egqoke ingubo yakhe emhlophe. Ubhadi lukhanya elangeni. Abantu abaningi bathi: "Ubhadi lwakhe luhle kakhulu! Ubani oluthungile?" ULulamile akakhulumi, kodwa uyajabula kakhulu.

Imibuzo:
Kungani abantu bethi uLulamile uyimpohlo?
Ngoba uneminyaka engamashumi amane, kodwa akashadile.
USthandiwe ufunani kuLulamile?
Ufuna ubhadi olusha lwengubo yakhe yomshado.
Kungani uSthandiwe ecela uLulamile ukuthi amkhethise?
Ngoba zonke izindwangu zinhle, futhi yena akazi ukuthi athathe yiphi.
ULulamile wenzani ngaphambi kokusika indwangu?
Uyayihlukuza kathathu ukuze uthuli luphume.
Yini eyenzeka lapho uSthandiwe egqoka ubhadi okokuqala?
Ubhadi luyamcindezela kancane, ngakho uLulamile uyaluvula eceleni.

lessons.title: Isijingi esilunama
lessons.summary: On his first week in the kitchen of a hotel in Ballito, young Mcebisi Mngoma lays the breakfast tables, then learns from the head cook Nonceba Mncwabe to make pumpkin porridge: he cooks it too long and it turns sticky, she shows him how to save it with milk, and they serve it with spinach to happy guests.
lessons.text:
UMcebisi Mngoma uneminyaka engamashumi amabili. Uqale umsebenzi ngesonto eledlule ehhotela elikhulu eBallito, eduze kolwandle. Usebenza ekhishini nompheki omkhulu, uNonceba Mncwabe. UNonceba ungumpheki onolwazi, osebenze kuleli hhotela iminyaka eminingi.

Ekuseni ngehora lesithupha uNonceba uthi: "Mcebisi, qala ngokudeka amatafula. Abantu bazofika bazodla ibhulakufesi ngehora lesikhombisa." UMcebisi uya ehholo elikhulu. Udeka itafula lokuqala: ubeka izitsha, imimese nezimfologo. Udeka itafula lesibili, nelesithathu. Udeka amatafula ayishumi. Uma eqeda, uNonceba uyeza azobheka. Uthi: "Udeke kahle. Kodwa ummese uhlala ngakwesokunene sesitsha, imfologo ihlala kolunye uhlangothi." UMcebisi ulungisa amatafula onke.

Bese uNonceba uthi: "Namuhla sizopheka isijingi. Isijingi singukudla kwakudala kwamaZulu. Senziwa ngethanga nangommbila ogayiwe." UMcebisi akazange asipheke isijingi ngaphambili. Ubheka uNonceba esika ithanga, alifake embizeni enamanzi. Ithanga liyabila. Bese uNonceba ethi: "Manje wena, faka ummbila, uxube njalo."

UMcebisi ufaka ummbila embizeni, axube. Kodwa ucingo lwakhe luyakhala, futhi uyakhuluma isikhathi eside. Isijingi sibila kakhulu. Uma ebuyela embizeni, isijingi silunama kakhulu. Sinamathela ebhodweni nasezandleni zakhe. UMcebisi uthi: "Nonceba! Isijingi silunama njengesinkwa esingavuthiwe!"

UNonceba akathukuthelanga. Uthi: "Lokho kwenzeka kubo bonke abapheki abasha. Isijingi silunama uma sibila isikhathi eside. Faka ubisi oluncane, uxube kancane." UMcebisi ufaka ubisi, axube. Manje isijingi asilunama kakhulu. Sithambile futhi simnandi. UMcebisi uthatha isijingi esincane, asidle. Uthi: "Yebo, manje silungile."

UNonceba uthatha isipinashi esiluhlaza. Uthi: "Isipinashi sihamba kahle nesijingi." Ugeza isipinashi, asisike, asiphekele isikhathi esifushane. Uthi: "Isipinashi asifuni ukubila isikhathi eside. Uma sibila kakhulu, siphelelwa umbala waso omuhle."

Ngehora lesikhombisa abantu bayangena ehholo. Bahlala ematafuleni uMcebisi awadekile. UMcebisi ubeka isijingi nesipinashi ematafuleni abo. Indoda endala ithi: "Lesi sijingi simnandi njengesikagogo wami!" Umfazi wakhe uthi: "Nesipinashi simnandi. Asinamafutha amaningi." UMcebisi uyajabula. Uthi kuNonceba: "Ngiyabonga ngokungifundisa." UNonceba uthi: "Kusasa uzopheka wedwa. Kodwa ungakhulumi ocingweni!"

Imibuzo:
UMcebisi wenzani kuqala ekuseni?
Uqala ngokudeka amatafula ehholo elikhulu.
Isijingi senziwa ngani?
Senziwa ngethanga nangommbila ogayiwe.
Kungani isijingi sikaMcebisi silunama?
Ngoba sabila isikhathi eside lapho yena ekhuluma ocingweni.
UNonceba umsiza kanjani?
Uthi akafake ubisi oluncane, axube kancane.
Kungani isipinashi singabili isikhathi eside?
Ngoba uma sibila kakhulu, siphelelwa umbala waso omuhle.

lessons.title: Umnyango owawuvuliwe
lessons.summary: Vuyo Dlungwane guards a big shop in Pinetown at night with his bulldog: in the confusion of the workers' departure one evening a door is left open, the bulldog barks at it, and inside they find the old storeman Mabizela asleep among the boxes, so Vuyo wakes him, sends him home and locks the door.
lessons.text:
UVuyo Dlungwane wayegada isitolo esikhulu sempahla yasendlini ePinetown ebusuku. Wayengasebenzi yedwa. Wayenobhova wakhe omkhulu onsundu. Ubhova yinja enekhanda elikhulu nomlomo obanzi. Abantu abaningi babesaba ubhova kaVuyo, kodwa wayeyinja ethulile, emthanda kakhulu uVuyo.

Njalo ngehora lesithupha kusihlwa kwakuba nokwemuka kwabasebenzi. Abasebenzi abangamashumi amane babeqeda umsebenzi, bathathe izikhwama zabo, baphume. Ngesikhathi sokwemuka kwakuba nesidididi esikhulu. Abanye babefuna amabhasi, abanye babekhuluma ocingweni, abanye babesadinga ukuvala amabhokisi. UVuyo wayefika ngemuva kokwemuka kwabo, lapho isidididi sesiphelile.

NgoLwesine olulodwa ukwemuka kwabasebenzi kwakunesidididi esikhulu kunakuqala. Iloli elikhulu lalifike kusihlwa kakhulu lilethe impahla entsha. Abasebenzi babegijima bethwala amabhokisi. Induna yabasebenzi yayikhuluma ngezwi elikhulu. Kwakungekho muntu owayazi ukuthi ubani okumele avale iminyango yonke.

Ngehora lesishiyagalolunye ebusuku uVuyo wayehamba nobhova wakhe ezungeza isitolo. Kwakumnyama, futhi kwakuthule. Ngokushesha ubhova wema. Waqala ukukhonkotha. Wayekhonkothela umnyango omncane ngemuva kwesitolo. UVuyo wabheka. Umnyango wawuvuliwe! Wawungavalwanga ngesikhathi sokwemuka.

UVuyo wathi: "Bhova, thula. Ake sibone." Wangena kancane, ubhova ehamba ngaphambili. Ngaphakathi kwakunamabhokisi amaningi. Ubhova waya eduze kwamabhokisi amakhulu, wema. Kwakukhona indoda elele phezu kwamabhokisi. Kwakungumkhulu Mabizela, osebenze nempahla esitolo iminyaka eminingi.

UVuyo wamvusa. Wathi: "Baba Mabizela! Wenzani lapha?" Umkhulu Mabizela wavula amehlo. Wathi: "Ngangikhathele kakhulu. Ngahlala phansi ngesikhathi sesidididi, ngalala. Akekho owangibona." UVuyo wahleka. Wathi: "Umnyango wawuvuliwe. Ubhova wami nguye owakubona."

UVuyo wafowunela indodana yomkhulu Mabizela, owafika ngemoto yakhe wamthatha. Bese uVuyo evala umnyango, awukhiye. Wawubheka kabili. Manje umnyango wawungasavuliwe.

Ngakusasa ekuseni uVuyo wabhalela induna incwadi. Wabhala wathi: "Ngesikhathi sokwemuka kunesidididi esikhulu. Umuntu oyedwa kumele abheke yonke iminyango ngaphambi kokuthi abasebenzi bemuke." Induna yavuma. Yathi: "Ubhova wakho uyinja ehlakaniphile." Kusihlwa uVuyo wanika ubhova wakhe inyama enkulu.

Imibuzo:
UVuyo wayesebenza nobani ebusuku?
Wayesebenza nobhova wakhe omkhulu onsundu.
Kungani kwakuba nesidididi ngesikhathi sokwemuka kwabasebenzi?
Ngoba abasebenzi abaningi babephuma ngesikhathi esisodwa, abanye befuna amabhasi, abanye bekhuluma ocingweni.
Ubhova wakhonkothelani?
Wakhonkothela umnyango omncane owawuvuliwe ngemuva kwesitolo.
Bathola bani ngaphakathi?
Bathola umkhulu Mabizela elele phezu kwamabhokisi.
UVuyo wabhalani encwadini yakhe?
Wabhala ukuthi umuntu oyedwa kumele abheke yonke iminyango ngaphambi kokuthi abasebenzi bemuke.

lessons.title: Isichwe esaba yilembe
lessons.summary: At a primary school in KwaMashu, the children call their young teacher Zinzile Mbonambi "Miss"; when they laugh at little Sbusiso for being the shortest in the class, she tells them the old tale of a short, clever man who tricks a hungry lion away from the cattle and becomes the village hero, and Sbusiso is proud.
lessons.text:
UZinzile Mbonambi ufundisa esikoleni samabanga aphansi KwaMashu. Ufundisa isiZulu nesiNgisi ezinganeni ezineminyaka eyisishiyagalombili. Uneminyaka engamashumi amabili nesithupha. Izingane zakhe azimbizi ngegama lakhe. Zithi "umisi". Njalo ekuseni zithi: "Sawubona, Misi!" Naye uthi: "Yebo, bantwana bami!" Umisi Mbonambi uyawuthanda umsebenzi wakhe.

NgoLwesithathu izingane zihlala ngaphandle ngesikhathi sokudla. USbusiso, ongumfana omncane kunabo bonke ekilasini, ufuna ukudlala ibhola. Kodwa abanye abafana bayahleka. Bathi: "Hamba, sichwe! Ubuncane bakho abukwazi ukudlala ibhola!" USbusiso uyakhala. Ubalekela kumisi.

Umisi akathukutheli, kodwa ubiza zonke izingane ekilasini. Uthi: "Hlalani phansi. Namuhla ngizonixoxela inganekwane endala. Yinganekwane yesichwe esaba yilembe."

Izingane zithula. Umisi uyaqala: "Kudala kwakukhona isichwe esasihlala esigodini esincane. Le ndoda yayincane kakhulu. Abantu babeyibiza ngokuthi 'Isichwe'. Kodwa isichwe sasiyihlakani. Sasicabanga kahle kunabo bonke abantu besigodi."

"Ngobunye ubusuku ibhubesi elikhulu elilambile lafika esigodini. Lalifuna izinkomo. Amadoda amakhulu namandla athatha imikhonto, kodwa esaba ukuphuma. Isichwe sathi: 'Ngizolixhosha ibhubesi.' Amadoda ahleka. Athi: 'Wena, sichwe? Uzokwenzani?'"

"Isichwe sathatha isikhumba senkomo esidala, sasigqoka. Sahamba siye ebhubesini sikhala njengenkomo egulayo. Ibhubesi lalandela isichwe. Isichwe sahamba kancane, saliholela ehlathini elikude, kude nesigodi. Lapho, sakhumula isikhumba, sagijima sabuyela ekhaya. Ibhubesi alizange liyithole indlela yokubuya."

"Ekuseni abantu bonke beza kusichwe. Bathi: 'Wena uyihlakani! Ungumuntu omncane, kodwa uyilembe lethu!' Kusukela ngalolo suku, abantu basibiza ngokuthi 'Ilembe', hhayi 'Isichwe'."

Umisi uqeda inganekwane. Ubuza izingane: "Kusho ukuthini lokhu?" Intombazane encane ithi: "Kusho ukuthi umuntu omncane naye angaba yilembe, uma eyihlakani." Umisi uthi: "Kunjalo. Ubuncane abusho lutho. Ingqondo yiyona into enkulu. Ihlakani alidingi ukuba lide."

Abafana abahleka uSbusiso bathi: "Uxolo, Sbusiso." USbusiso uyajabula. Uthi kumisi: "Misi, ngifuna ukuba yihlakani njengesichwe." Umisi uthi: "Usuvele uyihlakani, Sbusiso. Ekilasini uhlala uphambili." Bese zonke izingane ziyaphuma, zidlale ibhola ndawonye.

Imibuzo:
Izingane zibiza uZinzile Mbonambi kanjani?
Zimbiza ngokuthi "umisi".
Kungani uSbusiso ekhala?
Ngoba abanye abafana bayamhleka, bathi uyisichwe.
Isichwe sasingumuntu onjani?
Sasingumuntu omncane kakhulu, kodwa sasiyihlakani.
Isichwe salixhosha kanjani ibhubesi?
Sagqoka isikhumba senkomo, sahamba sikhala njengenkomo egulayo, saliholela ehlathini elikude.
Kungani abantu babiza isichwe ngokuthi "Ilembe"?
Ngoba sazisindisa izinkomo zesigodi ebhubesini.

lessons.title: Unesi omusha eNkandla
lessons.summary: Nomvelo Ngcamu, a student nurse at the hospital in Nkandla, learns the parts of the body from Doctor Ntanzi with a big picture on the wall, from the tip of the tongue to the anus, and that afternoon cares for old Mr Qwabe, who aches in old age and has cut the ridge of his nose in a fall.
lessons.text:
UNomvelo Ngcamu uneminyaka engamashumi amabili. Ufunda ukuba unesi esibhedlela saseNkandla. Lo nyaka ungunyaka wakhe wokuqala. Ekuseni ufunda ekilasini, emini usebenza nabanye onesi abadala. Ugqoka ingubo emhlophe yomsebenzi, futhi uyayithanda.

NgoMsombuluko udokotela Ntanzi ufundisa abafundi ngomzimba womuntu. Ulengisa odongeni isithombe esikhulu somzimba womuntu. Uthi: "Namuhla sizolandela ukudla, kusukela emlonyeni kuze kube sekugcineni." Ukhomba ulimi esithombeni. Uthi: "Lena yinkotha yolimi. Inkotha izwa ubumnandi bukashukela kuqala. Uma ufaka ushukela enkotheni, uzwa ubumnandi ngokushesha."

Abafundi bayahleka. UNomvelo ufaka ushukela omncane enkotheni yolimi lwakhe. Ngempela, uzwa ubumnandi.

Udokotela uqhubeka: "Ukudla kwehla kuye esiswini. Bese kudlula emathunjini. Ekugcineni okusele kuphuma ngomdidi." Ukhomba umdidi esithombeni. Abanye abafundi bayahleka futhi. Udokotela uthi: "Ningahleki. Umdidi uyingxenye yomzimba njengesandla noma ikhala. Unesi omuhle akanamahloni uma ehlola umdidi womuntu ogulayo. Umdidi nawo udinga ukuhlolwa njengolimi."

Emini uNomvelo usebenza nonesi omdala, uMlotshwa. Kufika umkhulu Qwabe, oneminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalombili. Uhamba kancane ngenduku. Uthi: "Ngicela ningisize. Ubuxhegu bunzima, bantwana bami. Ngizwa ukuqaqamba emadolweni nasemqoleni. Ukuqaqamba akupheli, ngisho ebusuku."

UMlotshwa uthi: "Baba, ukuqaqamba kwamadolo kuvamile ebuxhegwini. Udokotela uzokunika umuthi wokuqaqamba." UNomvelo ubheka ubuso bomkhulu Qwabe. Ubona igazi phezu kombombo wekhala lakhe. Ubuza: "Baba, kwenzekeni kumbombo wekhala lakho?"

Umkhulu Qwabe uthi: "Ngawa izolo ekhaya. Ngashaya umbombo wekhala etafuleni." UNomvelo ugeza umbombo ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Ubeka umuthi esilondeni, bese esivala ngendwangu encane emhlophe. Umkhulu Qwabe uthi: "Ngiyabonga, ntombi yami. Izandla zakho zithambile." UNomvelo uyamsiza ukuthi aphakame, ahambe naye kancane aze afike kudokotela Ntanzi. Udokotela umnika umuthi wokuqaqamba kwamadolo.

Kusihlwa uNomvelo ubhala encwadini yakhe: "Namuhla ngifunde ngenkotha nangomdidi. Ngisize umkhulu onobuxhegu nokuqaqamba. Ngageza umbombo wekhala lakhe." Ujabule kakhulu ngomsebenzi wakhe.

Imibuzo:
UNomvelo ufunda ukuba yini?
Ufunda ukuba unesi esibhedlela saseNkandla.
Kwenzekani uma ufaka ushukela enkotheni yolimi?
Uzwa ubumnandi bukashukela ngokushesha.
Udokotela uthini ngomdidi?
Uthi umdidi uyingxenye yomzimba, futhi unesi omuhle akanamahloni uma ehlola umdidi womuntu ogulayo.
Umkhulu Qwabe uzwa ukuqaqamba kuphi?
Uzwa ukuqaqamba emadolweni nasemqoleni.
Kwenzekeni kumbombo wekhala lomkhulu Qwabe?
Wawa ekhaya, washaya umbombo wekhala etafuleni.

lessons.title: Usuku olude epulazini
lessons.summary: On her small farm near Mtubatuba, Nontokozo Nzuza works from dawn to dusk: she opens the chicken house and gathers eggs, milks her female goat, trains a young ox to pull the plough beside an old one, and finds weevils in a bag of maize, which she dries in the sun before selling her eggs in town.
lessons.text:
UNontokozo Nzuza ungumlimi omncane eduze kwaseMtubatuba. Unepulazi elincane nezinkukhu ezingamashumi amabili, izimbuzi ezine nezinkomo ezimbili. Usebenza yedwa, kusukela ekuseni kuze kube kusihlwa.

Njalo ngehora lesihlanu ekuseni uNontokozo uvuka, aye ehhokweni. Ihhoko lakhe yindlu encane eyakhiwe ngezinti nangensimbi. Izinkukhu zilala ehhokweni ebusuku, ukuze izinja zasendle zingazidli. UNontokozo uvula ihhoko. Izinkukhu ziyaphuma, ziqale ukudla ummbila awuphonsa phansi. Bese uNontokozo engena ehhokweni, aqoqe amaqanda. Namuhla uthola amaqanda ayishumi nesishiyagalombili.

Emva kwalokho uya esibayeni sezimbuzi. Kunembuzikazi enkulu emhlophe, enezimbuzi ezincane ezimbili. UNontokozo uhlala phansi eduze kwembuzikazi, ayisenge. Imbuzikazi ithule, futhi inika ubisi oluningi. UNontokozo uthi: "Wena uyimbuzikazi enhle kunazo zonke. Ubisi lwakho lumnandi." Ubisi lwembuzikazi uluphuza nezingane zakhe, athengise olunye komakhelwane.

Bese uNontokozo eya ezinkomeni. Unenkabi endala nejongosi elisha. Ijongosi linonyaka owodwa nengxenye. Alazi ukudonsa igeja. Namuhla uNontokozo ufuna ukulifundisa. Ubopha ijongosi eduze kwenkabi endala, bese bobabili bedonsa igeja. Ekuqaleni ijongosi lesaba. Lifuna ukubaleka. Kodwa inkabi endala ihamba kancane, futhi ijongosi liyayilandela. UNontokozo uthi: "Kahle, jongosi lami! Kusasa sizophinda."

Emini uNontokozo uya endlini lapho egcina khona ummbila. Uvula isikhwama esikhulu sommbila. Ubona izilwane ezincane kakhulu ezimnyama phakathi kommbila. Yimbovane! Imbovane idla ummbila, futhi ingawuqeda wonke uma umuntu engenzi lutho.

UNontokozo uthatha ummbila wonke, awubeke ezindwangwini elangeni. Imbovane ayilithandi ilanga. Ngemuva kwamahora amabili imbovane iyaphuma emmbileni, ihambe. UNontokozo uhlanza isikhwama, aphinde afake ummbila owomile.

Emva kwalokho uNontokozo uthatha amaqanda, aye edolobheni ngebhasi. Uthengisa wonke amaqanda ezitolo ezincane. Ubuya ekhaya kusihlwa kakhulu. Uvala ihhoko, abheke izimbuzi nejongosi. Bese ehlala phansi, aphuze itiye elinobisi lwembuzikazi. Usuku lwakhe lunzima futhi lude, kodwa ujabule. Uthi: "Kusasa futhi ngizovula ihhoko ngehora lesihlanu."

Imibuzo:
Kungani izinkukhu zilala ehhokweni ebusuku?
Ukuze izinja zasendle zingazidli.
UNontokozo wenzani esibayeni sezimbuzi?
Usenga imbuzikazi enkulu emhlophe.
UNontokozo ufundisa ijongosi ukwenzani?
Ulifundisa ukudonsa igeja eduze kwenkabi endala.
Yini uNontokozo ayitholayo esikhwameni sommbila?
Uthola imbovane, izilwane ezincane ezimnyama ezidla ummbila.
UNontokozo uyixhosha kanjani imbovane?
Ubeka ummbila elangeni, ngoba imbovane ayilithandi ilanga.

lessons.title: Umumbi nesiqithi sikaGogo
lessons.summary: Near Mkhuze, Bonginhlanhla Mjoli earns his living as a digger: old Mrs Mkhwebane hires him to dig a plot of land for vegetables beside her marula tree, the rain-damp soil makes the work easier, and when he finishes they gather the fallen marula fruit together and she pays him with money and a bag of fruit.
lessons.text:
UBonginhlanhla Mjoli uhlala eduze kwaseMkhuze. Ungumumbi. Umumbi ngumuntu omba umhlaba ngefosholo, ukuze abantu batshale ukudla noma bakhe izindlu. Abantu abaningi baqasha uBonginhlanhla, ngoba usebenza kahle futhi ngokushesha. Ifosholo lakhe lidala, kodwa linamandla.

NgoLwesihlanu uGogo Mkhwebane uyamfowunela. Uthi: "Mfana wami, nginesiqithi esincane eduze kwendlu yami. Ngifuna ukutshala imifino khona. Ungakwazi ukumba isiqithi sami?" UBonginhlanhla uthi: "Yebo, Gogo. Ngizofika kusasa ekuseni."

Ebusuku imvula iyana kakhulu. Ekuseni umhlabathi uyaswakama. UBonginhlanhla uyajabula. Uthi: "Umhlabathi oswakamile ulula ukumba. Uma womile, unzima njengetshe." Ufika esiqithini sikaGogo ngehora lesikhombisa. Isiqithi sincane, kodwa sinamatshe amaningi nezimpande.

Eduze kwesiqithi kumi umganu omkhulu. Umganu yisihlahla esinezithelo eziphuzi ezibizwa ngokuthi amaganu. Phansi kwomganu kunomuwa omningi. Umuwa yizithelo ezisemhlabathini, ngoba ziwile esihlahleni. Amaganu amaningi awile ngenxa yemvula nomoya wasebusuku.

Umumbi uqala ukumba. Ukhipha amatshe, awabeke eceleni. Usika izimpande ngefosholo. Umhlabathi uswakama ngokwanele, ngakho ifosholo lingena kalula. Kodwa uBonginhlanhla uhamba kancane phansi kwomganu, ngoba akafuni ukulimaza umuwa. Uthi: "Gogo, ngicela ungitshele uma amaganu awile asebenza."

UGogo uyaphuma endlini ephethe ibhakede elikhulu. Uthi: "Yebo, asebenza kakhulu! Umuwa wamaganu ngiwenza utshwala obumnandi bamaganu. Kodwa umuwa kumele uqoqwe ngokushesha, ngaphambi kokuthi ubole."

Emini uBonginhlanhla useqedile ukumba isiqithi sonke. Umhlabathi umnyama futhi uswakamile kahle. UGogo uthi: "Wenze umsebenzi omuhle, mumbi wami. Manje ngisize siqoqe umuwa." Bobabili bahlala phansi kwomganu, baqoqe amaganu. Amaganu anuka kamnandi. Ngemuva kwehora ibhakede ligcwele. UGogo ubheka isiqithi. Uthi: "Kusasa ngizotshala isipinashi, amathanga nommbila. Umhlabathi osaswakamile uzosiza imifino ikhule ngokushesha."

UGogo unika uBonginhlanhla imali yakhe yomsebenzi. Bese emnika namaganu amaningi esikhwameni. Uthi: "Lawa ngawakho. Ubanike abantwana bakho." UBonginhlanhla uyabonga. Uthi: "Gogo, uma imifino yakho ikhula, ngizobuya ngizobheka isiqithi sakho."

Imibuzo:
Umumbi wenzani?
Umumbi umba umhlaba ngefosholo, ukuze abantu batshale ukudla noma bakhe izindlu.
Kungani uBonginhlanhla ejabula ekuseni?
Ngoba umhlabathi uyaswakama emva kwemvula, futhi ulula ukumba.
Umuwa yini?
Umuwa yizithelo ezisemhlabathini, ngoba ziwile esihlahleni.
UGogo wenzani ngomuwa wamaganu?
Uwenza utshwala obumnandi bamaganu.
UGogo unikani uBonginhlanhla?
Umnika imali yakhe yomsebenzi namaganu amaningi.

lessons.title: Uhambo nomgadi wezilwane
lessons.summary: Thembalihle Msibi, a game guard at Hluhluwe who greets the animals each morning as "my beasts", takes a group of schoolchildren on a walk: they see a bushbuck at the edge of the forest and a little steenbok in the grass over there, and when a black mamba crosses the path everyone stands still until it is gone.
lessons.text:
UThembalihle Msibi usebenza eHluhluwe. Ugada izilwane zasendle. Njalo ekuseni ugibela imoto yakhe, angene ehlathini. Uthi: "Sawubona, zilo zami!" Abanye abasebenzi bayahleka, kodwa uThembalihle uyazithanda izilwane. Uthi: "Zilo zami zidinga umuntu ozigadayo." Umsebenzi wakhe umningi. Uzibala izilwane, abheke ezigulayo, futhi abhale konke encwadini yakhe. Uma umlilo uqala ehlathini, uyawucisha nabanye abasebenzi.

NgoLwesibili kufika iqembu lezingane eziyishumi zesikole, nomisi wazo. UThembalihle uthi: "Namuhla sizohamba ngezinyawo. Kumele nihlale ndawonye, ningakhulumi kakhulu, futhi nilalele mina." Izingane ziyavuma.

Bahamba kancane endleleni encane eduze kwehlathi. Ngokushesha uThembalihle uyema. Ukhomba eduze kwehlathi. Uthi ngezwi eliphansi: "Bhekani. Yimbabala." Izingane zibona imbabala enombala onsundu, enamabala amhlophe. Imbabala iphakamisa ikhanda layo, ibheke abantu. Bese ingena ehlathini ngokushesha. UThembalihle uthi: "Imbabala iyasaba. Ithanda ukuhlala ehlathini, lapho ingabonwa khona."

Baqhubeka nohambo. Phambili kunotshani obude obuluhlaza. UThembalihle uthi: "Bhekani utshani lobuya! Kukhona into encane lapho." Izingane zibheka utshani lobuya. Kunesilwane esincane esinombala obomvu nonsundu. "Yiqhina," kusho uThembalihle. "Iqhina lincane kunembabala. Lidla utshani obuluhlaza." Iqhina lilalele umsindo, bese ligijima lingena otshanini. UThembalihle uthi: "Iqhina livame ukuhlala lodwa. Nembabala ivame ukuhlala yodwa ehlathini."

Emva kwalokho inyoka ende emnyama iphuma otshanini, inqamula indlela ngaphambili kwabo. UThembalihle uphakamisa isandla. Uthi: "Yimani! Ningahambi! Yimamba." Bonke bema ndawonye, bathule. Izingane zibona ukuthi imamba yinde kakhulu, cishe amamitha amabili. Imamba ayibheki abantu. Iyahamba, ingene otshanini kolunye uhlangothi lwendlela.

Ngemuva kwesikhathi esifushane uThembalihle uthi: "Manje singaqhubeka." Intombazane encane ithi: "Bengesaba kakhulu!" UThembalihle uthi: "Kuhle ukwesaba imamba. Imamba inobuthi obubulalayo. Kodwa imamba ayifuni ukulwa nabantu. Uma simile, ayisilimazi."

Kusihlwa izingane zigibela ibhasi lazo. Zithi: "Siyabonga, Thembalihle!" Umfana omncane ubheka emuva, ekhuluma ngezwi elikhulu: "Salani kahle, zilo!" Umisi wakhe uthi: "Uyabona? Nawe usukhuluma njengoThembalihle." UThembalihle uyahleka.

Imibuzo:
UThembalihle uthini kuzilwane njalo ekuseni?
Uthi: "Sawubona, zilo zami!"
Imbabala yenzani lapho ibona abantu?
Iphakamisa ikhanda layo, bese ingena ehlathini ngokushesha.
Yisiphi isilwane izingane ezisibona otshanini lobuya?
Zibona iqhina, isilwane esincane esinombala obomvu nonsundu.
Bonke benzani lapho imamba inqamula indlela?
Bema ndawonye, bathule.
Kungani kuhle ukwesaba imamba?
Ngoba imamba inobuthi obubulalayo.

lessons.title: Incwadi yomcwaningi wezintini
lessons.summary: In her work diary, the researcher Phiwayinkosi Xulu writes about three days in the Drakensberg: she climbs a long ridge to a high plateau where a river runs, counts the otters that live in it and photographs a young one, and on the last morning sees a small weasel near the little hut where she sleeps before she walks back down the ridge.
lessons.text:
NgoMsombuluko
Igama lami nginguPhiwayinkosi Xulu. Ngingumcwaningi wezilwane. Emsebenzini wami ngifunda ngezintini. Intini yisilwane esihlala emanzini nasemhlabathini. Inomzimba omude, uboya obunsundu obuthambile, nomsila omude onamandla. Intini idla izinhlanzi namaqanda ezinyoni. Kulo nyaka ngenza ucwaningo ngezintini ezihlala emfuleni omncane eDrakensberg.

Namuhla ngihambe ngezinyawo amahora amahlanu. Indlela ikhuphuka imbombo ende yentaba. Imbombo yindawo ende ephakeme lapho izinhlangothi zentaba zihlangana khona. Phezu kwembombo umoya wawunamandla kakhulu futhi kwakubanda. Kodwa ngabona kude kakhulu, ngabona nezintaba eziningi.

NgoLwesibili
Ekuseni ngifike empakameni. Impakama yindawo ephakeme, kodwa phezulu ilingana njengetafula elikhulu. Kule mpakama kunotshani obuluhlaza, amatshe amakhulu nomfula ohamba kancane. Eduze komfula kunendlwana encane yabacwaningi. Ngibeke izinto zami endlwaneni.

Emini ngihlale ngithule eduze kwamanzi isikhathi eside. Ekugcineni ngabona izintini ezintathu. Intini enkulu yayibhukuda emanzini, ifuna izinhlanzi. Ezinye izintini ezimbili zazidlala phezu kwetshe elikhulu. Enye yazo yayincane kakhulu. Ngicabanga ukuthi yintini encane eyazalwa kulo nyaka. Ngathatha izithombe eziningi ngocingo lwami. Ngabhala konke encwadini yami.

Ebusuku kwakubanda kakhulu empakameni. Ngabasa umlilo omncane eduze kwendlwana, ngapheka itiye. Phezulu kwakunezinkanyezi eziningi. Ngezwa umsindo emanzini. Ngicabanga ukuthi kwakuyizintini, zifuna ukudla ebumnyameni. Izintini zisitshela okuningi ngomfula. Uma izintini ziphila kahle, kusho ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile futhi kunezinhlanzi eziningi. Uma izintini zingasekho, kusho ukuthi kukhona okubi emanzini. Ngakho ngizibala njalo ngonyaka.

NgoLwesithathu
Namuhla kuqala ngibone ubhozo. Ngaphuma endlwaneni ekuseni kakhulu. Ubhozo lwaluhlezi eduze kwamatshe. Ubhozo yisilwane esincane kunentini, esinomzimba omude nomncane, nomsila omude. Lwangibheka isikhashana, bese lugijima lungena phakathi kwamatshe. Ngijabule kakhulu, ngoba abantu abaningi abazange balubone ubhozo empakameni.

Emini ngiqoqe izinto zami. Ngehle ngembombo kancane. Ukwehla kwakulula kunokukhuphuka, kodwa manje nginokuqaqamba emadolweni. Ngiyabonga ngezinsuku ezintathu empakameni. Ngibone izintini, ngibone ubhozo. Ngenyanga ezayo ngizobuyela empakameni futhi.

Imibuzo:
UPhiwayinkosi Xulu ungubani?
Ungumcwaningi wezilwane, ofunda ngezintini.
Intini idlani?
Intini idla izinhlanzi namaqanda ezinyoni.
Izintini zisitshelani ngomfula?
Uma izintini ziphila kahle, kusho ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile.
Imbombo yini?
Yindawo ende ephakeme lapho izinhlangothi zentaba zihlangana khona.
UPhiwayinkosi wabona izintini ezingaki emfuleni?
Wabona izintini ezintathu.
Kungani uPhiwayinkosi ejabule ngokubona ubhozo?
Ngoba abantu abaningi abazange balubone ubhozo empakameni.
